text: 创业板指高开低走翻绿，煤炭、航运板块集体走强。 恒指早盘基本持平，恒生科技指数跌0.6%，联想集团涨超5%。 美伊战事推升布油逼近100美元关口，亚洲芯片股延续涨势，韩国股市一度涨2%，SK海力士涨逾3%。 中国8月CPI同比涨幅扩大至0.8%，PPI同比涨3.8%，环比双双转正。 报道：灵巧手相关国标预计年底对外公示。
text_en: ChiNext opened higher but fell into the red; coal and shipping sectors rallied collectively. Hang Seng Index roughly flat in morning trade, Hang Seng Tech Index down 0.6%, Lenovo Group up over 5%. US-Iran conflict pushed Brent crude near the $100 mark; Asian chip stocks extended gains, with South Korea's KOSPI up 2% at one point and SK Hynix rising over 3%. China's Aug CPI YoY widened to 0.8%, PPI YoY rose 3.8%, with both turning positive MoM. Report: National standards for dexterous hands expected to be publicly announced by year-end.
